sections.name: LEGAL AVERMENTS
sentences: Plaintiff is a member of a protected class under Title VII as a Black woman.

Plaintiff was also subjected to adverse employment actions as listed above, which included, but were not limited to, being denied raises, promotions and being paid less than her less senior, less qualified White coworkers.
A determinative or motivating factor in the adverse employment actions Defendant took against Plaintiff was Plaintiff’s membership in the protected categories as outlined in this Complaint.
The discrimination was purposeful, intentional and willful, and was either undertaken by members of upper management or members of upper management were willfully indifferent to the discrimination.

Because the discrimination was intentionally egregious and because members of upper management either participated in the discrimination or were willfully indifferent to the discrimination, punitive damages are warranted.
As a result of the unlawful conduct outlined above, Plaintiff has been forced to suffer economic and non-economic harm.

sections.name: PLAINTIFF’S ALLEGATIONS
sentences: Plaintiff began working for Defendant in 2000.
Plaintiff currently works in the position of Director of Recruitment Services.
On or around January 31, 2020, Plaintiff’s supervisor at the time, Jack Heur, sent out a message promoting eight employees to the position of Director, including Plaintiff.
Heur is a White man and his job title at the time was the Senior Vice President of Human Resources.
In addition to Plaintiff, two White women were also promoted to director positions.
Their names were Nicole Torsella Harris and Rhonda Cates.
Plaintiff was more senior, experienced and qualified for the job than both Harris and Cates.
Harris began working for Defendant in 2013.
In that year, Harris applied for the position of Executive Recruiter.
Harris did not meet the requirements for the position, and a more qualified Black woman, Kimberly Douthit, also applied for the position.
Despite her inferior qualifications, Defendant hired Harris for the position.
Heur and the Senior Vice President and Chief of Staff, Greg Rost, insisted Defendant hire Harris.
After Defendant hired Harris, Plaintiff was responsible for training Harris.
It is Plaintiff’s understanding that Harris earned a salary comparable to Plaintiff’s despite the fact Plaintiff was more experienced, more qualified and had more seniority than Harris.
Defendant hired Cates in 2017.
In 2020, Defendant promoted Cates to the position of Director of Human Resources and Finances.
Defendant then promoted Cates again to the position of Executive Director.
That position was never posted.
Cates earned more than Plaintiff despite the fact Plaintiff is more experienced, more qualified and has more seniority than Cates.

sections.name: DISCRIMINATION BASED ON RACE UNDER TITLE VII
sentences: Plaintiff hereby repeats and realleges the preceding paragraphs as though fully set forth herein.
Plaintiff was subjected to discrimination based on race that had an adverse effect on her employment as outlined above.

WHEREFORE, Plaintiff demands judgment against the Defendants jointly, severally and in the alternative, together with compensatory damages, including emotional pain and suffering, punitive damages, interest, cost of suit, attorneys’ fees, enhanced attorneys’ fees, equitable back pay, equitable front pay, equitable reinstatement, equitable instatement or promotion, and any other relief the Court deems equitable and just.

Plaintiff requests the following equitable remedies and relief in this matter: a. Plaintiff requests a declaration by this Court that the practices contested herein violate Federal and State law as set forth herein. b. Plaintiff requests that this Court order the Defendant to cease and desist all conduct inconsistent with the claims made herein going forward, both as to the specific Plaintiff and as to all other individuals similarly situated. c. Plaintiff requests, that in the event that equitable reinstatement and/or equitable back pay and equitable front pay is ordered to the Plaintiff, that all lost wages, benefits, fringe benefits and other remuneration is also equitably restored to the Plaintiff. d. Plaintiff requests that the Court order the Defendant to alter its files so as to expunge any reference to which the Court finds violates the statutes implicated herein. e. Plaintiff requests that the Court do such other equity as is reasonable, appropriate and just.
